authority.obligation: The native module reads all supplied argument values before whitelist dispatch. An ignored key does not prove no reference emission.

producerBoundary.finiteValueAuthority: Existing native/declared foreign language-name catalog or accepted finite code; unknown scalar, rich/dynamic value, blank, duplicate or competing native/mapped Language hint is refused. This does not restrict already active native idioma/língua/etc values.

guardBoundary.wholeCitationAssociation: Ordered Language key/raw-value rows are bound to the remaining literal argument rows of their same citation, including anchorless native calls.
guardBoundary.rawOpaqueOwner: The complete refused native langue call remains raw and ordered against reference markers and collectors. The ordinary observer remains unchanged, including child events.
approvedSourceComposition: fresh whole-source ignored citation header plan/proof with its original stage
fresh whole-source source compatibility plan/proof with its original stage
disjoint local citation Language/field/metadata/person/protocol plans under original options and whole-source stage permissions
fresh original named-reference v27-references edits, retaining the first source body
existing unnamed identical-reference producer under original options
exact existing endMatterPass SOURCE append as a separate bounded proof

appendBoundary.required: Complete closed main-namespace wikitext source, enabled endMatter/references, known complete nonempty common-group reference outside every opaque owner, no existing renderer/helper or other protected/identity uncertainty.
appendBoundary.ownerRefMarkers: Complete raw ref markers may remain uncertain. Their bytes and material order are retained. No child template/parser function/triple braces/references tag/unknown extension or malformed ref syntax is admitted.
appendBoundary.exactEndpoint: The original endMatterPass result must be the original source byte for byte followed solely by one literal {{Referências}} and its existing LF boundary.
appendBoundary.proofRepresentation: A zero-width edit at the inclusive EOF boundary of a protected owner is refused. Only after exact SOURCE prefix+suffix proof, a containing source-span edit represents the same sole append and must pass original StageSafeEdits with rule/stage endMatter. It grants no general owner edit.
appendBoundary.scopeOfPlan: The same proof can hold with an opaque owner earlier than EOF if the existing producer yields the exact original+append endpoint.

countsPolicy: Action scenarios, idempotence repeats, guard-only transactions, fresh/stale proof controls and timing probes are reported separately. Core/full replay is not an additional distinct source/options/expected scenario.
publicPrivacy: All examples are fictional. Primary references use anonymous immutable oldid URLs and content hashes. No user/editor paths, account access, Wikipedia writes or external requests occur.
